sections.heading: Plants produce glucose using sunlight.
sections.body: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants produce glucose. Plants require sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to complete this process. Oxygen is released as a byproduct.

sections.heading: Chlorophyll absorbs light energy.
sections.body: Chlorophyll is the pigment found in plant leaves. It absorbs light energy from the sun. This energy powers the photosynthesis process.

key_terms.definition: the process by which plants produce glucose using sunlight
